summary: Altimmune filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for a public offering of common stock and warrants. The offering of 64.25M shares at $3.00/share plus pre-funded warrants raised ~$211.2M net proceeds, closing on April 24, 2026. Proceeds fund Phase 3 MASH trial of pemvidutide and pre-commercial activities. This is a routine equity financing, not a special situation.
